component_details.name: ProductListItem
component_details.current_renders: Re-renders on every parent state change (search, filter, modal state)
component_details.optimization_target: Only re-render when product prop actually changes

performance_context.issue: With 50+ products, typing in search or opening modals causes noticeable lag
performance_context.solution: Wrap ProductListItem with React.memo to prevent re-renders when props haven't changed
performance_context.impact: Significant performance improvement for large product lists
